en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing an outdoor barbershop scene. Several men sit on simple wooden chairs under a large tree while barbers shave or cut their hair, with towels draped around the customers' shoulders. In the background are low buildings and a fence, giving the impression of a street or market area. On the right margin there is printed red text in French, and at the bottom appears a website watermark added later.
